items.title: Vercel Daemons can now call services with bindings
items.summary: can now call the  in their deployment through .Vercel Daemonsservicesservice bindingsDeclare the binding on the daemon. It names the target service and the environment variable that receives the service's URL:The daemon calls that URL like any other HTTP endpoint. Vercel handles the internal routing, authentication, and TLS, and the service stays private:Bindings point one way: services can't bind to daemons. Each instance keeps calling the deployment that started it, even after a promotion or rollback.Learn more about daemon service bindings in the .docsRead more
